XFined Editor third-party notices
=================================

LZO 2.10
--------

Copyright (C) 1996-2017 Markus Franz Xaver Johannes Oberhumer.

XFined Editor statically links LZO under GNU GPL version 2 or, at your option,
any later version. The unmodified corresponding source is vendored under
Source/External/LZO, and the complete license is distributed beside the editor
as LZO_LICENSE.txt.

FreeType 2.14.3
---------------

Portions of this software are copyright © 2026 The FreeType Project
(https://freetype.org). All rights reserved.

XFined Editor uses FreeType under the FreeType Project License. The complete
license and the upstream dual-license overview are distributed beside the
editor as FREETYPE_LICENSE.txt and FREETYPE_LICENSE_OVERVIEW.txt.

OpenAL Soft 1.25.2
------------------

XFined Editor dynamically links the unmodified official OpenAL Soft router and
implementation. OpenAL Soft is licensed under the GNU Library General Public
License version 2 or, at your option, any later version. The complete license
is distributed beside the editor as OPENAL_SOFT_COPYING.txt. The corresponding
source is available from:

https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft/releases/tag/1.25.2

OpenAL Soft includes a modified PFFFT implementation. Its complete BSD-style
notice is distributed beside the editor as OPENAL_SOFT_LICENSE_PFFFT.txt.
